title: Bind DWG INSERT output names through source BLOCK_RECORD handles

source.repositoryStatus: local untracked test input; intentionally not added to Git

witness.reason: Anonymous source block names are made unique in the planned DXF BLOCK_RECORD list; the decoded INSERT name alone does not identify the referenced source block.

nextPhysicalBlocker.reason: The source payload uses a code outside the documented normal XRECORD group-code domain. Strict conversion retains refusal; this receipt does not infer a DXF representation from another converter's output.

implementation.summary: Strict full-document writing resolves a DWG INSERT's source blockRecH through the already planned source-handle/name maps and emits the unique planned BLOCK_RECORD name. It refuses absent targets and 64-bit source handles that cannot be represented by the current 32-bit identity map. Name-only resolution remains the fallback when no source handle is supplied; R12 behavior is unchanged.
implementation.failureBehavior: The focused ASCII/Binary test checks unresolved target and unindexed wide-handle refusal, destination sentinel preservation, corrected same-writer retry, and exact emitted group-2 target.

isolatedSelector.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary; group 2 is *U6 for source handle 0xA002 after the reader-facing name *U, and invalid attempts preserve the destination before a corrected same-writer retry.

physicalSource.result: Expected strict failure advanced beyond extension-graph and INSERT target admission; conversion stops before OBJECTS staging at XRECORD 0x121F, group 1071.
physicalSource.effect: Physical staged-byte and whole-graph output qualification remain pending.

focusedTests.result: INSERT selector and compound INSERT owner roundtrip pass. The adjacent block-owner adapter/CLI controls fail during extension-graph preflight because their generated source lacks a usable LAYER TABLE control; failure occurs before INSERT emission and is not counted as resolver evidence.

completedActionsRemoved: Resolve a DWG INSERT's source BLOCK_RECORD handle to its unique emitted name, including missing and wide-handle refusal, exact ASCII/Binary output, rollback and retry.
planImpact.remainingP4Scope: Keep strict refusal for the source XRECORD 0x121F group-1071 payload until a supported representation has independent semantic backing. After an eligible route exists, prove physical BLOCKREPRESENTATIONDATA staged fields, owner and block-reference role with fresh readback. Continue the separate Title_Block-ARCH dictionary 0x1116 graph and SORTENTSTABLE closure.
